stock.description: Nanjing Sinolife United Company Limited functions as an investment holding entity primarily involved in the manufacturing, processing, and global distribution of nutritional supplements. Its operations span the People's Republic of China, Australia, New Zealand, Vietnam, and various international markets. The firm additionally produces and markets cosmetics and skincare items, while also undertaking the trading, retail, and testing of pre-packaged health food products. Products are sold under well-known brands such as Good Health, Zhongsheng, Hejian, and Cobayer, primarily via its comprehensive network of retail outlets. Distribution also encompasses sales through distributors, television shopping channels, online e-commerce platforms, chain pharmacies, specialized health food supermarkets, and tourist souvenir shops. The company, which has been headquartered in Nanjing, China, since its establishment in 1999.
